alignments.note: The lamed of the superscription is rendered For.
The article assimilated into the pointed preposition is a real token (rule 12) and takes the ASV the.
Piel participle of nṣḥ = one who directs; Chief carries the lexeme of overseeing and Musician is the specifier the ASV supplies (rules 24, 31). Heading on Musician remains defensible.
The Hebrew superscription is only lamnaṣṣēaḥ ləḏāwiḏ; no mizmôr stands here, so the italicized A Psalm is licensed by no morpheme (rules 7, 30).
The lamed of authorship/dedication is rendered of.
The perfect takes its English auxiliary; the explicit subject noun is its own unit (rule 17).
The anarthrous substantival adjective licenses the determiner the ASV supplies (rules 15, 29 spirit); it is not added.
The pronominal suffix takes the possessive (rule 18); reordered target token.
The negative existential supplies the whole frame There is no, headed on the negation that carries its lexeme (rules 21, 24).
Subject of the verbless negative clause.
The ASV renders the hiphil with a copular predicate; subject pronoun and copula belong to the verb's unit, headed on the lexical predicate corrupt.
The hiphil of tʿb is the abominable acting itself, so abominable carries the lexeme while have done is the English periphrasis; heading on done remains defensible.
The accusative noun ʿălîlāh is rendered works.
The second negative existential is separately rendered There is none, parallel to the first occurrence; not a case for rule 22 since the ASV renders it.
The relative that the ASV supplies for the substantival participle belongs to it.
The ASV renders the participial construct with a direct object rather than of, so this unit takes only good (rule 28 spirit).

review_notes: Ledger checked: all 18 source IDs and all 33 target IDs are partitioned exactly once across 19 units; no invented IDs.
Accepted alignment judged correct and returned unchanged; only note wording was tightened with rule citations.

s003: kept Chief as target head because נצח supplies the directing/preeminence sense while Musician is the noun the ASV supplies; a reader preferring the substantive Musician has a defensible alternative, hence medium confidence.
s005/t005-t006: the italic A Psalm is genuinely unlicensed here (no מִזְמוֹר in this superscription), so the italic markup and the added label agree; this is not a case of rule 7 overriding markup.
s007: The before fool is a supplied determiner attached to the noun that licenses it, not an added unit; contrast rule 12, where a real [הַ] token exists in the superscription.
s014: alternative head done (English lexical verb) versus abominable (Hebrew lexeme of תעב) — retained abominable per rule 24's lexeme-first criterion, flagged medium.
